tectonic2
Apache License, Version 2.0

The structural analysis engine. Compiled into the engine library that this mod carries
(libbsi_tectonic.so / bsi_tectonic.dll) together with the BSI host, and reached through the
five C functions of contract/bsi_capi.h.

Source: https://github.com/rocky59487/tectonic2

either express or implied. See the License for the specific language governing permissions
and limitations under the License.

The full text travels with this artefact as META-INF/LICENSE.

The exact revision each shipped library was built from is recorded in the engine's own
handshake reply, which the build reads rather than asserts: the manifest field
engineVersion in blockreality-engine/natives.manifest carries engine name, version and
build revision, and a build from a modified worktree is marked -dirty there.
